item.title: Assam's Month-Long Pork Ban in Seven Districts to Be Lifted Following Weeks of Containment

item.description: GUWAHATI: The Assam Cabinet on Thursday, December 18, approved the transfer of government land in favour of Brahmaputra Valley Fertilizer Corporation Limited (BVFCL) for the execution of the AVFCCL Namrup-IV Ammonia-Urea Brownfield Project, alongside a series of decisions covering land rights, security infrastructure, sports appointments and ecological protection. item.title: Assam CM Pulls Up GMDA, GMC Over Unsafe High-Rise Approvals Along Drains, Riverbanks
item.description: GUWAHATI: Chief Minister Dr Himanta Biswa Sarma on Thursday, December 18, came down heavily on the Guwahati Metropolitan Development Authority (GMDA) and the Guwahati Municipal Corporation for allowing large-scale high-rise constructions along natural drains and riverbanks in the city, calling the practice “dangerously negligent”. item.title: Seven Elephants Killed, One Calf Injured After Rajdhani Express Hits Herd in Assam’s Hojai
item.description: GUWAHATI: Seven elephants were killed and one calf sustained critical injuries after the Sairang–New Delhi Rajdhani Express collided with a herd at a place under Jamunamukh Police Station in Assam’s Hojai district in the early hours of Saturday, December 20.
